name: ak:react-best-practices
overview: Apply React and Next.js performance optimization patterns from Vercel Engineering. Use for component optimization, rendering performance, bundle analysis.
whenToUse: Invoke for React/Next.js performance and rendering issues.

subcommands.name: async-defer-await
subcommands.desc: Move await into branches where actually used

subcommands.name: async-api-routes
subcommands.desc: Start promises early, await late in API routes

subcommands.name: bundle-conditional
subcommands.desc: Load modules only when feature is activated

subcommands.name: bundle-preload
subcommands.desc: Preload on hover/focus for perceived speed

subcommands.name: server-cache-lru
subcommands.desc: Use LRU cache for cross-request caching

subcommands.name: server-serialization
subcommands.desc: Minimize data passed to client components

subcommands.name: client-swr-dedup
subcommands.desc: Use SWR for automatic request deduplication

subcommands.name: rerender-defer-reads
subcommands.desc: Don't subscribe to state only used in callbacks

subcommands.name: rerender-memo
subcommands.desc: Extract expensive work into memoized components

subcommands.name: rerender-derived-state
subcommands.desc: Subscribe to derived booleans, not raw values

subcommands.name: rerender-functional-setstate
subcommands.desc: Use functional setState for stable callbacks

subcommands.name: rerender-lazy-state-init
subcommands.desc: Pass function to useState for expensive values

subcommands.name: rendering-animate-svg-wrapper
subcommands.desc: Animate div wrapper, not SVG element

subcommands.name: rendering-hydration-no-flicker
subcommands.desc: Use inline script for client-only data

subcommands.name: js-batch-dom-css
subcommands.desc: Group CSS changes via classes or cssText

subcommands.name: js-cache-function-results
subcommands.desc: Cache function results in module-level Map

subcommands.name: js-combine-iterations
subcommands.desc: Combine multiple filter/map into one loop

subcommands.name: js-length-check-first
subcommands.desc: Check array length before expensive comparison

subcommands.name: js-min-max-loop
subcommands.desc: Use loop for min/max instead of sort
